fact: The Times reports that a National Data Centre incident disrupted at least 12 government digital platforms including the Government in Your Hand application, e-Visa, company registration and the Elderly Grant Application and Payment system, with company registration online services affected per the ministry.
The Digital Landscape Assessment Report, as reported, found only 31 of 419 government services currently available online, the rest remaining paper-based and manual.

Google Cloud's Africa lead Basil Ayass refers to downloading the Ministry of ICT application or visiting the e-services portal, in the launch of the Ministry's Google partnership to advance the Government in Your Hand initiative.
Eswatini's ICT ministry said on 23 October 2026 that 13 government online services, including the Government in Your Hand platform and e-Visa, had been restored after disruptions.
